context: List .github/workflows with push: develop and no schedule. Classify: safety-critical vs advisory. For safety-critical without schedule, file follow-up TODOs or extend detectors. Document accepted risks in docs/operations.
description:
develop-post-merge-silently-skips-pushes / PR #1599 bounds push-drop for develop-post-merge.yml only (schedule tip sweep + gap detector). Other workflows that fire only on push to develop (or path-filtered develop push) share the GitHub delivery class: silent missing runs with no scheduled backstop.

Batch residual (overall review nit #6): inventory and decide per workflow whether a schedule backstop, gap detector, or accepted risk note is required. Do not blindly add hourly full suites.

preserves.behavior: No new workflow permissions beyond existing; cost-conscious schedules (slim gates)

verifications.description: Ops inventory exists naming at least develop-post-merge and one other workflow

work_units.evidence: Enumerated develop-push workflows from .github/workflows/ (re-verified against develop tip 2026-08-06): develop-post-merge.yml (hourly 17 * * * *), orphaned-commit-detector.yml (bare push, daily 0 7 * * *), submission-validator-drift-check.yml (weekly Mon 0 6 * * 1), sync-results-data-to-published.yml (NO schedule), results-explorer-browser.yml (NO schedule). PR #1632.

docs/operations/develop-push-drop-inventory.md: inventory table with role (safety-critical vs advisory), residual push-drop risk and disposition per subject; explicit non-entries; related scheduled canaries; cost/policy constraints; manual recovery cheatsheet. Linked from develop-post-merge-gaps.md. PR #1632.
work_units.summary: Classify safety-critical vs accepted risk; write ops inventory table

work_units.evidence: No follow-up TODO filed and no new backstop workflows added, by design. Both schedule-less subjects are documented accepted risk with compensating controls: sync-results-data-to-published.yml is bounded by the daily read-only corpus-drift-check.yml canary (deliberately not putting a write-capable public-branch mirror on cron); results-explorer-browser.yml is bounded by the pre-merge required check, with an hourly Playwright suite rejected on cost. Guardrail 'no new workflow permissions; cost-conscious schedules' preserved: PR #1632 changes no workflow files. Drift guard test re-derives the subject set from .github/workflows/ and fails if the table diverges.
work_units.summary: Open follow-up TODOs or implement minimal backstops only for critical gaps
